create_noise_background.description: Make a square PNG of small tiles in shades of one colour: a texture for a web page, a slide, an email header or a social post. Give it a colour or let it pick one, choose how many tiles and how big, and whether they vary in brightness or in hue. The image is saved so later steps can attach or upload it, and the colour used is reported. No account or API key required.
create_noise_background.name: create_noise_background

parameters.description: Optional. The colour to build the noise from, as a hex colour. Leave it blank and a random colour is picked; the colour used is reported either way, so a later step can match text or a border to it.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: How many tiles across and down. The image is always square: at the default tile size, 50 tiles make a 350 pixel image and 10 make a 70 pixel one.
parameters.name: tiles

parameters.description: How many pixels each tile is across. Small tiles read as a fine grain, big ones as a bold mosaic.
parameters.name: tile_size

parameters.description: Width in pixels of the grid drawn between the tiles. 0 means no grid, so the tiles touch. In Brightness mode the grid is drawn in your colour itself, with the tiles in its shades.
parameters.name: border_width

parameters.description: How the tile colours are made from your colour. Brightness keeps the hue and varies how light each tile is, for a subtle texture; Around picks colours near yours, which reads as more colourful.
parameters.name: mode

options.label: Brightness, lighter and darker shades of your colour
Around, colours close to yours, which reads as more colourful

parameters.description: Brightness mode only. How far apart the shades are, as a percentage of brightness per step. 1.5 gives a subtle grain; 5 or more gives a bold one.
parameters.name: shade_spacing

parameters.description: Brightness mode only. How many shades to make lighter than your colour, and how many darker, so 5 gives up to 11 colours in all.
parameters.name: shade_steps

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the image under. Named after the colour by default, e.g. noise-0b2545.png.
parameters.name: filename

description: Make noise background images with PHP-Noise, the free and open source generator at php-noise.com. Give it a colour, or let it pick one, and get back a square PNG of small tiles in shades of that colour: a texture for a web page, a slide, an email header or a social post. Choose how many tiles and how big, whether a grid runs between them, and whether the tiles vary in brightness or in hue. Make one image, a matching set from a palette, or an image encoded inline for a stylesheet. No account or API key required.
